prompt: Whose baseball sports cards have been sold for over a million dollars the most times? For the same card, only the highest sale value is counted.
answer: **Mickey Mantle**—his cards have recorded **23 distinct sales above $1 million**, the most among baseball players. For comparison, Honus Wagner has 19 and Babe Ruth 13. These figures reflect publicly known sales, counting only the highest qualifying sale for any individual card.
